html:
Start with RESULTS.mdObjectives: related Puzzle Armory multipliers/diagnostic ZIP, unsigned Electrum .txn, public exports mSIGNA/CoinQ. This is a research of sources and formats; the search for keys does not run.

  • FORMATS.md Useful fields and limits of recognition.
  • LINK_TRIAGE.md - decisions on 68 URL, Distinguish between content reading and context selection.
  • SOURCES.json, cache-network/ - raw public responses, URL, UTC and hashes. cache/ preserves early errors DNS sandboxes.
  • TARGETED_ARCHIVE_QUERIES.json, TARGETED_POST_REVIEW.json, search-*.json - saved target search.
  • CONTENT_SCAN.json, ARCHIVE_INTEGRITY.json, PSEUDO_XPUB_66.json, ACCEPTANCE.json - reproducible checks.
  • INPUT_PINS.json fixes the four files used E10. They are read on the next path, not copied on 170 MiB.

From the root of the project, without a network:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

mine.py It only repeats the extraction from the saved E10, without a net. fetch.py urls-01.json --network similar lists 02/03 use a separate cache of the allowed network run; the existing response is checked by hash and not re-downloaded. archive_queries.py --network - eight intermittent requests ≥1 s and three-page limit on 200 records; in the accepted launch, each ended on the first page URL We need a new catalogue/So as not to lose the old answer.

Downloaded scripts and programs don't run. General .venv, old reports, search projects and checkpoints They don't change. In general research README Only a reference to this stage has been added.
